items.title: SWTOR botting and Lua scripting
items.text:
GoS-SWTOR / Lua developer documentation

Read the world. React to events. Create your own tools.

GoS-SWTOR supports SWTOR botting with Lua combat routines and addons. Install published scripts and their declared shared dependencies through the Official Script Library, or build your own overlays, event processors and gameplay automation with the public Lua API.

items.title: Abilities and commands
items.text: Ability lookups accept a case-insensitive display name or an exact current opaque ability_handle. Ability metadata is local-player-only.

items.title: gos.abilities.loadout()
items.text:
Returns the selected local loadout:

{
  status = "pending" | "ready" | "unavailable",
  action_bar_available = boolean,
  action_bar_truncated = boolean,
  combat_style = string | nil,
  discipline = string | nil,
  talents_available = boolean | nil,
  known = { [ability_or_active_talent_display_name] = true } | nil
}

The last four fields are present only when status == "ready". known contains currently owned abilities and active talents. The active talent set includes both selectable choices (for example Force Mobility) and automatically learned/passive progression rows (for example Force Shelter). Talents remain distinct from ability metadata internally: presence in known does not make a passive castable or give it an ability_handle. Talent discovery is enrichment only; a transient invalid talent snapshot never makes the owned-ability loadout unavailable. When talents_available=false, missing talent names are not proof that those talents are unselected. Action-bar availability is independent of loadout identity; an empty or incomplete bar does not imply a player-session change.

local loadout = gos.abilities.loadout()
if loadout.status ~= "ready" then
  return
end

if loadout.combat_style == "sage" and
   loadout.discipline == "Telekinetics" and
   loadout.known["Telekinetic Gust"] then
  -- Exact current loadout match.
end

items.title: Ability Row
items.text:
gos.abilities.action_slots() returns a pure array of current on-bar rows. Use loadout().action_bar_available and action_bar_truncated to distinguish a coherent empty bar from missing/incomplete observations. gos.abilities.info(ability) returns one matching row, including a known off-bar row, or nil.

{
  name = string,
  name_source = "client" | "core",
  on_bar = boolean,
  ability_handle = "ability:..." | nil,
  activation_handle = "ability:..." | nil,
  slot_index = integer | nil,
  key_number = integer | nil,
  ready = boolean,
  submission_pending = boolean,
  has_cooldown_remaining = boolean,
  cooldown_remaining = number | nil,
  has_cooldown_duration = boolean,
  cooldown_duration = number | nil,
  has_current_charges = boolean,
  current_charges = integer | nil,
  has_max_charges = boolean,
  max_charges = integer | nil,
  has_resource_cost = boolean,
  resource_cost = number | nil,
  has_line_of_sight_requirement = boolean,
  line_of_sight_required = boolean | nil
}

slot_index is zero-based. ability_handle is accepted by ability lookup and submission functions. activation_handle is for comparing activation and event identity; do not pass it as the submission ability.

name_source identifies observed client text versus Core-derived display text; Core text may differ from localized UI spelling. Name-based ability queries prefer the current on-bar group over historical off-bar rows and reject distinct IDs with the same matching name within that group. Duplicate bindings of one ID remain valid. Use the ability_handle for an unambiguous lookup.

Charge and resource fields remain absent until their current observations are available. Do not infer charge counts or costs from timers.

has_line_of_sight_requirement says whether the requirement is known; only then is line_of_sight_required meaningful. This metadata is not a visibility test. Use the cast-readiness result to observe whether line of sight was actually checked.

items.title: gos.abilities.info(ability)
items.text:
Returns the matching prepared Ability Row or nil. In addition to the shared row fields, a returned info row includes metadata_request_status:

Value Meaning registered A metadata request was registered pending An existing request remains pending deferred_capacity Request capacity is full; try on a later tick satisfied The current row satisfies the request invalid No request can be made in the current context

Requests are serviced later and are not permanent subscriptions. satisfied does not prove castability or guarantee every optional field; check has_* flags and optional values. A known off-bar row can return invalid because requests currently require an on-bar ability and valid script/player context. The row is still usable. metadata_request_status belongs only to info(), not action_slots() rows. Retry pending requests on a later tick.

items.title: Readiness Helpers
items.text: These helpers read prepared local-player observations. Timers use seconds; nil means the observation is unavailable, rather than a zero timer.

items.title: gos.abilities.cooldown_remaining(ability)
items.text: Returns observed remaining cooldown in seconds, or nil when the ability or its cooldown observation is unavailable.

items.title: gos.abilities.cooldown_duration(ability)
items.text: Returns observed total cooldown duration in seconds, or nil when the ability or its duration observation is unavailable.

items.title: gos.abilities.gcd_remaining()
items.text: Returns the local player's observed global cooldown in seconds, or nil when the snapshot or GCD observation is unavailable.

items.title: gos.abilities.is_ready(ability)
items.text: is_ready() reads the resolved ability row's readiness flag and returns false when the row is unavailable. It does not perform the target-specific validation done by can_cast(). A ready row does not prove target visibility, facing, range or command admission.

items.title: gos.abilities.is_casting_or_channeling()
items.text: Returns the current busy observation as a boolean. It can remain true briefly while current_cast() is nil because busy state and named cast identity have different availability. A missing ability snapshot also returns false.

items.title: gos.abilities.current_cast()
items.text:
Returns the current cast/channel observation, or nil when its active snapshot is unavailable:

{
  ability_handle = "ability:..." | nil,
  name = string,
  has_timing = boolean,
  remaining = number | nil
}

name is "-" when the display name is unavailable. remaining is in seconds and is present only when has_timing=true.
